text: Seismic separation: buildings and structures with different dynamic behaviour shall be separated by seismic joints with a width not less than the sum of the DD-2 displacements (with a minimum of 100 mm for pipe rack to building and 150 mm for building to building); pipe crossings across joints shall be designed for the relative displacement. Turbine and generator foundations shall be independent of building foundations and floors (ER-13.01).
